description: K₂NaCo(NO₂)₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3 space group. K is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form KO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share edges with six equivalent KO₁₂ cuboctahedra and faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. All K-O bond lengths are 2.98 Å. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share faces with eight equivalent KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.74 Å. Co is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent N atoms. All Co-N bond lengths are 1.99 Å. N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Co and two equivalent O atoms. Both N-O bond lengths are 1.25 Å. O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one N atom.
